metric_definitions.definition: Commerzbank country-specific average number of employees, with part-time personnel converted to full-time equivalents.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: CbCR raw taxes on income — Commerzbank
metric_definitions.definition: Commerzbank raw country-specific taxes-on-income field. Expense is represented with a positive raw sign; normalization is not performed in this source-fact metric.
Country-specific turnover as reported by Commerzbank under §26a KWG; preserved separately from Deutsche Bank net revenues.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: CbCR employees — Deutsche Bank year-end FTE
metric_definitions.definition: Deutsche Bank CbCR employees in full-time equivalents at the reporting-date timepoint; 2018–2020 time basis is inferred from the table timepoint and marked as such.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: CbCR net revenues — Deutsche Bank reported
metric_definitions.definition: Country-by-country net revenues as reported by Deutsche Bank under §26a KWG; not silently equated with Commerzbank turnover.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: CbCR raw income tax field — Deutsche Bank
metric_definitions.definition: Deutsche Bank raw CbCR income-tax expense/benefit field. Expense is represented with a negative raw sign; normalization is not performed in this source-fact metric.

Derived normalized tax expense divided by positive PBT. ETR is not applicable for non-positive PBT. Negative ratios are preserved as tax-benefit cases, not interpreted as low ETR. This metric is contextual only and not a cross-bank ranking or misconduct indicator.

Derived sign-normalized tax expense from the bank-specific raw CbCR tax field. Deutsche Bank raw expense is multiplied by -1; Commerzbank raw expense is retained. Negative normalized values indicate tax-benefit / negative-tax-expense cases and are not low-ETR flags.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: CbCR profit or loss before tax
metric_definitions.definition: Country-by-country pre-tax profit or loss as reported in the bank's §26a KWG table.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: CbCR profit or loss before tax per FTE
metric_definitions.definition: Derived PBT per reported FTE. Deutsche Bank uses year-end FTE, Commerzbank average FTE; therefore cross-bank ranking is blocked. Negative values represent loss per FTE. No Germany-relative ratio is persisted.
